name: update-event
description: Updates or changes an Outlook calendar event: its subject, text body, time, location, attendees or online call setting. The event id comes from microsoft-outlook__list-events. Outlook notifies attendees of changes; an attendee list given replaces the event's list.

start.description: The new start date and time in Microsoft Graph dateTime format, for example 2025-01-15T09:00:00.

end.description: The new end date and time in Microsoft Graph dateTime format, for example 2025-01-15T10:00:00.

timeZone.description: The time zone used for supplied start and end values. Defaults to UTC.

location.description: The event's new location display name.

attendees.description: The complete replacement attendee list. Use an empty array to remove all attendees.

type.description: The attendee type. Defaults to required.

isOnlineMeeting.description: Whether this event is an online meeting.
